description: Carbon mineralization potential using 24 hour rewetting at ~50% water filled pore space (with a fixed mass of soil and volume of water) measured with SR-1. This column is calculated by SHI depending on the raw data reporting unit (see resp_24hr_raw and resp_24hr_raw_unit) and the ideal gas law. Where the resp_24hr_raw_unit value is "ppm CO2-C (AAL)" or "ppm CO2-C (Ward)", the calculation is  resp_24hr_raw*40*(44/12)/(0.9*0.215/.082/298)/1000/.04 where 40*(44/12) converts the value back into the raw CO2 concentation in ppm, and (0.9*0.215/.082/298)/1000 is the conversion to mg CO2-C. 0.9 in the term (0.9*0.215/0.082/298)/1000 is the pressure in atm based on elevation where the analysis was performed. 0.215 is the typical volume of air in mL in a half pint jar with 40 mg soil and 9 mL of water. 0.082 is the constant R. 298 is the lab temperature in K.  0.04 is the mass of soil in kg.
